capabilities: sync inverse relation properties between linked notes
preview proposed changes per note or across the vault
define custom relation pairs with synonyms
undo the last recorded sync batch
exclude paths from the sync engine
disambiguation: Not a vault or file syncing tool; it only mirrors relation properties between paired notes inside one vault.
extras: New installations start with automatic sync paused; the README advises backing up the vault before vault-wide syncs, and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian links are one-directional, so adding a relation property like mother to one note does not add the inverse property to the linked note.
summary: Frontmatter plugin that keeps inverse relation properties in sync, writing the matching link to the other note when you add or change one.
